name: Nyack Boat Club Junior Sailing
description_short: Junior sailing program at the Nyack Boat Club on the Hudson for ages 8 to 16, Monday to Friday 9 am to 4 pm, teaching sailing in Optimist prams and, for older and advanced sailors, Club 420s.

fees.name: Junior Sailing Seasonal Membership
fees.note: Plus NY sales tax; one per family, required unless the family holds a general Nyack Boat Club membership

notes: Both sessions together cost $3,600. 10% off for a second child. Families who aren't general club members join as Junior Sailing Seasonal members ($900 plus tax per family). General members had priority registration through February 28. Both 2026 sessions were full with a waitlist when checked; apply by emailing the forms on the page.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Junior Sailing page: 2026 Session 1 June 29 to July 24 (not July 3) $2,300 and Session 2 July 27 to August 14 $1,650, both full with waitlist; both $3,600; ages 8 to 16; Optimist prams and Club 420s; 9 to 4; $900 seasonal membership plus tax for non members; club address 59 Gedney Street, Nyack, NY 10960. Outdoor inferred from a sailing program.
